verses.pali: “Aṭṭhime, bhikkhave, dhammā bhāvitā bahulīkatā anuppannā uppajjanti, nāññatra sugatavinayā.
verses.english: “Mendicants, these eight things don’t arise to be developed and cultivated apart from the Holy One’s training.
They are: right view, right purpose, right speech, right action, right livelihood, right effort, right mindfulness, and right immersion.

verses.pali: Ime kho, bhikkhave, aṭṭha dhammā bhāvitā bahulīkatā anuppannā uppajjanti, nāññatra sugatavinayā”ti.
verses.english: These are the eight things that don’t arise to be developed and cultivated apart from the Holy One’s training.”
